categories.title: Un Poco Loco
categories.intro: [laughs] Grab your guitar and your marigolds! This one's all about Pixar's Coco.

clues.clue: In Coco, Miguel dreams of playing this instrument like his idol.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the guitar! [excited] Miguel just wants to play. Is that so loco?

clues.clue: Miguel's family has banned music and makes these for a living instead.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is shoes! [chuckles] The Riveras are a VERY serious shoe family. No singing on the job.

clues.clue: This charming skeleton trickster helps Miguel in the Land of the Dead and turns out to be family.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Héctor! [sighs] The real songwriter all along. Justice for Héctor!

clues.clue: Coco won the Oscar for Best Original Song for this tender tune.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Remember Me! [whispers] Grab the tissues. I said TISSUES. Plural.

clues.clue: The glowing orange bridge to the Land of the Dead is made of the petals of this flower, cempasúchil.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is marigolds! [excited] Cempasúchil, the flower of the dead. TRUE Coco fans nailed that one.

categories.title: It's a Small World After All
categories.intro: [sarcastic] I promise not to sing it... [laughs] okay, I might hum it. It's all about the happiest cruise that ever sailed!

clues.clue: Name this Disneyland boat ride with the whimsical white-and-gold facade.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is it's a small world! [laughs] And now it's in your head. You're welcome.

clues.clue: The ride debuted at the 1964 New York World's Fair as a salute to this children's charity.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is UNICEF! [excited] A ride for the children of the world, from the very start.

clues.clue: This Disney Legend artist created the ride's bright, flat, colorful style.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mary Blair! [chuckles] Rolly Crump made some of the toys, but the look? That's ALL Mary.

clues.clue: These songwriting brothers wrote the ride's famous song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sherman Brothers! [laughs] They meant it as a round you could sing in any language. Mission accomplished.

clues.clue: After the World's Fair, it's a small world opened at Disneyland in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1966! [dramatic pause] Sixty-ish years of that song. Impressive. Exhausting. Mostly impressive.

categories.title: World Showcase Stopover
categories.intro: [laughs] Next stop... the world! We're strolling around EPCOT's World Showcase.

clues.clue: EPCOT's World Showcase pavilions circle around this body of water.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is World Showcase Lagoon! [chuckles] Seven Seas Lagoon is over by Magic Kingdom. Different water, same splash.

clues.clue: This five-story pagoda, pictured, stands in which EPCOT pavilion?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Japan! [excited] Modeled on an ancient pagoda in Nara. Gorgeous.

clues.clue: EPCOT's China pavilion features a half-scale replica of this famous temple in Beijing.
accept: hall of prayer for good harvests
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Temple of Heaven! [whispers] Look up inside. It's as gorgeous as the real thing.

clues.clue: The Italy pavilion's bell tower is modeled on the one in St. Mark's Square in this city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Venice! [laughs] Gondolas included. Canals... sold separately.

clues.clue: EPCOT's Morocco pavilion has a replica of the minaret of this famous mosque in Marrakesh.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Koutoubia Mosque! [excited] Morocco's minaret, in Florida. TRUE World Showcase nerd!
